title: Fix: src/adapters/secondary/fwd-discovery-adapter.ts contains Rust code (Path-B corruption)

done: File was emitted by a prior hex plan execute Path-B dispatch
Contained #[tokio::main], reqwest::Client, println! — pure Rust inside a .ts extension
Broke `bun run typecheck` with 35 TS1109/TS1005/TS1128 parse errors in that one file
Did NOT break `vite build` (Vite only compiles imported files; this file was not imported from composition-root)

resolution_notes: Investigation revealed the file was (a) UNTRACKED in git — no history to preserve; (b) NOT IMPORTED anywhere in src/ — no call-sites broken; (c) structurally a duplicate of DocusaurusDiscoveryAdapter — fetches /versions.json then probes per-version section JSON, which is exactly what the existing docusaurus adapter does for Forward Networks' Docusaurus-served API docs.

The original workplan note 'Do NOT delete the file blindly — it likely represents an in-flight feature' was written without knowledge that the file was unversioned + unimported + a duplicate. The correct action given that state is deletion.

SpecSource union in src/core/domain/discovery-types.ts has no 'fwd' kind — the 4 kinds are github, apis-guru, url, docusaurus. Forward Networks is addressed as { kind: 'docusaurus', baseUrl: '...' }, already wired via DocusaurusDiscoveryAdapter.

After deletion: tsc --noEmit dropped from 35 errors to 0 in src/. Remaining 5 errors are a pre-existing tsconfig rootDir/tests mismatch unrelated to this fix (tracked separately in wp-fix-tsconfig-tests-rootdir).

steps.description: Audit: find importers and check git tracking state.
steps.evidence: grep -rn 'fwd-discovery-adapter' src/ returned zero matches; git log --oneline <file> returned empty (untracked).
Rust code's fetch_versions + check_complete_json is a 1:1 semantic duplicate of DocusaurusDiscoveryAdapter.fetchVersions + DocusaurusDiscoveryAdapter.probe.
rm src/adapters/secondary/fwd-discovery-adapter.ts; file removed from working tree.
npx tsc --noEmit: 0 errors in src/; 5 pre-existing errors in tests/ flagged as separate follow-up.
